psychological_meaning: Gun Powder evokes feelings of sophistication, mystery, and subdued strength. Its muted, dark grey tones suggest stability and understated elegance, while also hinting at a hidden intensity and potential. It can represent neutrality, formality, and a sense of quiet power.
